name: alert-dialog
useFor: Use to confirm an action that cannot be undone or that loses work (Delete sandbox, Leave the team). Say what happens in the description, name the action in the key (Delete sandbox, not OK), and pass variant="destructive" to AlertDialogAction when it deletes. AlertDialogMedia adds a hexagon mark with a glyph above the title.
constraints: A confirmation for an action that can be undone
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website's popups and keys: the square ground panel (.hn__sheet), the hexagon keys (.button, .button--line), the orange as the mark of a destructive action from the brand principles.
title: Alert Dialog
description: The dialog's square ground panel for a decision that a click outside cannot dismiss: 448px (384px small) with a deep soft cast over the ink at 32 percent, a Chakra Petch light 20px title, a 14px graphite description, an outlined Cancel hexagon and the action as an ink hexagon, or orange when it destroys something. A dialog taller than the screen scrolls and fades at the screen edge it scrolls past (fade-y).
